title: NNSA enterprise-baseline hold: GAO's exact recommendation remains Open
summary: GAO-23-104661 remains Open because a GAO-aligned lifecycle cost estimate is still absent; the December 2026 forecast and other portfolio-governance closures do not satisfy the exact recommendation.
